chunks: Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid (rh) narrated to us. He said: al-Hasan b. Matil al-Daqqaq narrated to us. He said: Ya'qub b. Yazid narrated to us from al-Hasan b. Ali b. Faddal from al-Daylami -- and he is Sulayman -- from Abdullah b. Latif al-Taflisi. He said: Al-Sadiq Abu Abdillah Ja'far b. Muhammad (as) said:

When al-Husayn b. Ali (as) was struck with the sword, and they prepared to sever his head, a caller called from the direction of the Lord of Glory, Blessed and Exalted, from the depth of the Throne, saying: 'O perplexed and misguided nation after its Prophet! Allah will not grant you success in Adha nor in Fitr.' Then Abu Abdillah (as) said: By Allah, they were never granted success, nor will they ever find success, until the Revolutionary of al-Husayn (as) rises.

key_terms.الْأُمَّةُ الْمُتَحَيِّرَةُ الضَّالَّةُ: the perplexed and misguided nation; refers to those who abandoned their Prophet's family
key_terms.بُطْنَانِ الْعَرْشِ: the innermost depth of the Divine Throne; signifies the gravity and celestial origin of the proclamation
key_terms.ثَائِرُ الْحُسَيْنِ: the Revolutionary/Avenger of al-Husayn; a title for the awaited Imam al-Mahdi who will avenge al-Husayn's martyrdom

ai.seo_question: What did Allah's caller proclaim from the Throne when Imam al-Husayn was martyred at Karbala?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) narrates that when Imam al-Husayn (AS) was struck down at Karbala and they moved to sever his head, a divine caller from the depth of Allah's Throne condemned the nation for going astray after their Prophet, decreeing they would never find blessing in their Eid celebrations. The Imam swears by Allah that this curse remains in effect and they will never be granted divine success until the Revolutionary of al-Husayn -- the awaited Imam al-Mahdi -- rises to avenge him.
